pages.title: CFU-7 Hearthstone
pages.text: ORSA's fission reactor. Fuel rods make heat; radiators turn it into power.

pages.title: History
pages.text: ORSA ran CFU-7s at its outposts. When everyone evacuated, no one stayed to watch them. $(danger)Every one melted down.$()$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA would like you to do better.$()

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: $(li)Fuel rods heat the core$(li)Coolant carries the heat to radiators outdoors$(li)The heat they shed becomes power$(li)The controller joins your grid as a 16-block node

pages.title: Before You Build
pages.text: $(li)Uranium, mined deep$(li)A powered $(l:power/induction_furnace)Induction Furnace$(/l)$(li)Radiators with an outdoor face$(li)Distance or lead against $(l:radiation/basics)radiation$(/l)
